_about: The exact surfaces every wall lies on, and their images in the half-cell (the surface library): each plane by its normal (n . beta = 0), each curved surface as a polynomial in the betas (monomials as index lists, coefficients) taken at A beta (A the group element carrying the wall's own surface there). Frozen once from the library the walls' pieces were built on; this file is now the definition. Every number is exact in Q(sqrt 5): 'exact' gives each as [a, b, c] = (a + b sqrt 5) / c (a plane's normal up to scale, then normalised; a curved surface's coefficients times coeff_scale), and the stored values are those numbers to full double precision.
